values.note: Book through the Fair Office, (716) 366-4752, by filling in the fair's camping application/contract: one for Fair Week and one for any other week. Sites are assigned by the fair; one vehicle and one unit per site. Fair-week sites must be paid in full by late June or are forfeited and re-rented.

booking.source: https://www.chautauquacofair.org/campgrounds ('We have several sites that are open for campers throughout the year. Whether you want to rent a site during Fair Week or another week, click on the appropriate "Application" button'; 'Any questions can be directed to the Fair Office') + https://www.chautauquacofair.org/_files/ugd/429caa_5a8db01004a84314bfc7c60114c28f1b.pdf (NON-FAIR CAMPING CONTRACT 2026: Date In / Date Out, nightly rates, 'You will be assigned a site number', 'Only one vehicle & unit per site') + https://www.chautauquacofair.org/_files/ugd/429caa_5f16ca4bf696406098bddda66dd2e11c.pdf (CAMPING CONTRACT 2026: 'Payment must be made in full by June 27 to secure your site. Any site not paid for by June 26 will be forfeited'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Several sites' stay open all year; the rest are for Fair Week.

season.source: https://www.chautauquacofair.org/campgrounds ('We have several sites that are open for campers throughout the year'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every site has electric and water: sites 1-28 and 49-58 electric and water, 29-48 add sewer, and sites 20 (19 on the fair-week form) and 59-82 have 20/30/50-amp receptacles with sewer and water; the Central Ave. sites have 20-amp, 110-volt electric and water.

hookups.source: https://www.chautauquacofair.org/_files/ugd/429caa_5a8db01004a84314bfc7c60114c28f1b.pdf ('Camp Site Elec and water ... sites1-28, 49-58'; 'Camp Site Elec. water & Sewer ... sites 29-48'; 'Camp Sites #20 & 59-82 have 20amp-30amp and 50 amp. RV receptacles with sewer and water'; 'Central Ave. sites Electric and water') + https://www.chautauquacofair.org/_files/ugd/429caa_5f16ca4bf696406098bddda66dd2e11c.pdf ('Camp Sites #19 & 59-82'; 'Central Ave. Electric 20amp,110-volt, Water'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Non-fair camping 2026: Central Ave. electric (20 A, 110 V) and water $25, electric and water $30, electric, water and sewer $35, 50-amp full hookup $45 a night, plus card fees. The fair-week contract charges the same nightly rates.

fees.source: https://www.chautauquacofair.org/_files/ugd/429caa_5a8db01004a84314bfc7c60114c28f1b.pdf ('Elec and water ... $ 30.00', 'Elec. water & Sewer ... $35.00', '20amp-30amp and 50 amp ... with sewer and water ... $ 45.00', 'Central Ave. sites Electric and water ... $25.00', '(plus current cc fees)') + https://www.chautauquacofair.org/_files/ugd/429caa_5f16ca4bf696406098bddda66dd2e11c.pdf (same rates), read 2026-10-21

note: Chautauqua County Fairgrounds, Dunkirk. 80+ sites; camping is not limited to fair week. --Claude
summary: Fair Association campground: confirmed $25-45/night 2026 (non-fair and fair-week contracts alike), booking by application/contract through the Fair Office (assigned sites), year-round for 'several sites'; added hookups (50 A at sites 20/59-82, water at all, sewer at 29-48 and 59-82). Note trimmed of the booking text. Not stated: site count beyond the numbering (1-82 plus Central Ave.), lengths, showers/dump outside fair week.
flags: Possible criteria check (inclusion): outside fair week the fairground rents only 'several sites' year-round by mailing a contract/application to the Fair Office (no online booking, no phone booking stated); nightly rates are posted, so it is not event-only.
